local.description: In-memory and simulated execution validating protocol schemas, serialization, and status transitions without submitting transactions to live networks.

live.description: Execution against deployed live network infrastructure requiring on-chain transaction finality and Horizon validation. Cannot be claimed unless deployed tests passed.
